areaSpecies.drawAreaHint: Tap the map to redraw this list's area
areaSpecies.selfIntersectDraw: The shape crosses itself; please redraw

areaSpecies.areaSavedBox: The outline could not be used; its bounding box was saved
areaSpecies.errRateLimit: GBIF is rate-limiting this client. Wait a few minutes, or narrow the area and groups.
